sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 12.5.2023 in connection with Crime No. 145/2023, registered at Police Station Gadasarai District Dindori for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5L of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix has been examined in the Court and she is turned hostile.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that offence is serious in nature.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix has been examined and she is turned hostile.
6.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that prosecutrix has been examined and she is turned hostile, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
